Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Bangladesh's reply. The home side will be confident enough to chase this down, but you never know as Sri Lanka has a god record over Bangladesh, in Bangladesh. Sri Lankan players are seen to be in a huddle before they make their way on the field. Litton Das and Soumya Sarkar walk out to open for the hosts. Dilshan Madushanka to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

For Lanka, the problem was, their batters couldn't make most of the starts they got. Mendis and Liyanage both got to half tons but none went on to make it big. They kept losing wickets at crucial junctions and in the end failed to play out the fifty overs. They'll feel they are at least 20 short of what could have been a par total. They will need to bowl well if they to restrict Bangladesh. Early wickets will be key. The hosts will back themselves to chase it.

That is a really good bowling performance from Bangladesh and we feel they’ll surely be the happiest of the two sides at the moment. Especially after the start Lanka got after electing to bat. Their openers got them off to an absolute flier adding 50 in no time. Once that stand was broken, Bangladesh managed to pick wickets quite regularly. The three pacers were excellent. Especially Tanzim Hasan Sakib. Mehidy Hasan was really good in the middle overs along side Shoriful. Taskin Ahmed came back strongly towards the end. Taijul Islam was a touch expensive but the others covered up by bowling well.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sri Lanka have been bowled out for 255. What a catch from Tanzim Hasan Sakib. Shoriful Islam picks up this third wicket. Short ball, on off. Dilshan Madushanka swings hard at it. The ball flies towards point off the outside edge. Tanzim Hasan Sakib there judges the ball really well, makes the leap and pouches it safely.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold in near the deck and informs most of the time teams win on this venue while chasing. Informs that there is some grass on the track, also the pitch is very hard. TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and ELECTED TO BAT!

Bangladesh on the other hand, will be out for revenge. They have the likes of Mushfiqur Rahim, Mehidy Hasan and Taijul Islam back and they'll hope their experience can come into use. They would also hope the change in ground would change fortunes. Can they turn things around? We will find out.

It is Lanka who emerged victorious in the T20I series. They thrashed Bangladesh in the third T20I to seal the deal and they would looking to do more of the same in the ODIs. They more or less have the same squad and we believe on paper, they are the better side.

Down with the T20I series and it is time for ODI format. Bangladesh and Lanka will taking on each other in a three-match ODI series. We welcome you to the coverage of the first one. Let's hope this is an absolute cracker. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.
